title: Dodds, Helm and Holm influences and his changing style
summary: He admired Johnny Dodds but never copied him, found Helm too wild, and now thinks he sounds too much like George Lewis.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: What did you still have some of the, uh, I can't think of the name of that guy.
Will Johnny Dodds and the Waters clarinet players in your playing, do you feel that? Or has that influence gone out of your playing?

I never had a great Johnny Dodds influence in my playing, although I admired his playing very much. I just didn't think that it was worthwhile somehow trying to copy him. I heard a lot of chaps who did and got pretty good copies and they sounded a bit corny somehow always. I think Dodds had a bit of fire that others just couldn't copy even if they copied note for note what he played. So my playing was never a Dodds style, it was certainly not a Bob Helms style, I think he was the one, wasn't he, with Lou Wonders?
He was one of the ones and there was another one who I like even better than I do Helms and I can't think of his name. Yes, I know who you mean.
He was a rather... Holm? Yeah, Alice Holm. That's right, that's right. That's the one I'm trying to... A little more disciplined. Helm I couldn't take, I thought he got out of tune just
much too much altogether. Too wild. Too wild.

Yes. But my style changed quite a lot and I was very much criticised by the old gang as a sort of traitor. My style's been influenced, it's a bit too much like George Lewis I suppose at present, but I'll get over it I think. Well, before that you don't really have a model, huh? Oh, they always used to say I was more like Homer Simeon. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. It's sort of a... It's sort of a... a lot of... It's a bit too much like George Lewis I suppose at present, but I'll get over it I think.
Well, before that you don't really have a model, huh?
Oh, they always used to say I was more like Homer Simeon. I don't... I don't know. Sort of a long term with a lot of people is a very interesting question.
